newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-GERMANS USE EUROPEAN FINAL TO PROMOTE WORLD CUP BID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMANS USE EUROPEAN FINAL TO PROMOTE WORLD CUP BID.

text.p: Germany will be using Wednesday's European Cup final in Munich to promote its bid to host the 2006 World Cup finals.

The German soccer federation (DFB), which is facing a rival European bid from England, has organised a gala for hundreds of officials and journaliststs at a Munich theatre on the eve of the final between Borussia Dortmund and Juventus.

The gala will be co-hosted by former World Cup-winning captain and coach Franz Beckenbauer who is heading the DFB bid. Guests will be shown details of Germany's plans for the finals, including a promotional video.
